name: Step Progress
description: A four-step onboarding stepper: each active step pulses, its label brightens, the node fills with a sprung check, the rail fills to the next step, and a preview panel hands over to each step's view; the last step bursts.
move: A four-step onboarding stepper: each active step pulses, its label brightens, the node fills with a sprung check, the rail fills to the next step, and a preview panel hands over to each step's view; the last step bursts.
how: Deterministic draw(t). ACT/DONE times drive colour mixes (Flow cubic), node fills and checks (damped spring), rails (scaleY, Flow cubic) and a live pulse ring. Panel views hand over in sequence (out, then in) so two text blocks never overlap. Eight-stroke burst on completion.
adapt: Edit STEPS (label, sub, icon, panel title/copy) and ACT/DONE timing. Placeholder copy is generic. Colours come from the palette tokens at the top of the page (--bg, --surface, --ink, --muted, --accent, --accent-2); change those to re-brand it.
port: Pure draw(t): mount the markup in the shot and call draw from the film's frame hook with shot-local time; wait for fonts before measuring.
caveats: Original implementation of the "Stepper" motion-design idea; no third-party preset, kit or brand assets.
Starts and ends on its opening frame so it loops; trim the exit when cutting to the next shot.
